description: A small roll of birchbark with cord, to tie around wounds to help stop bleeding and protect from dirt.  It's better than nothing.
//: Copied from Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead 0.I, data/mods/innawood (the wilderness mod by Lightwave, in the CDDA repository under its CC BY-SA 3.0 licence): the mod's new items and those of its recipes that do not replace a recipe the base game has.

description: Birchbark bandages with added garlic salve.  They're better for wounds but not as good as real bandages.
A bundle of cables around an iron core.  Useful for controlling voltage.
A makeshift hand-powered battery charger based on homopolar generator.
A 12V lead-acid battery used to power car electrical systems, contained in a clay shell.
//: 58Ah @ 12VDC. Could supply ~700 watts for an hour

description: A set of 4 clay car batteries wired together in series in a simple wooden frame.
//: 4 batteries in a box

description: This is a set of tools to repair damaged metal tools and armor.  It uses charcoal, contained in a small clay vessel, to heat the part and make it easier to work.
This is the outer casing of a light battery.  It will need to be refilled to be useful.
This is the outer casing of a medium battery.  It will need to be refilled to be useful.
This is the outer casing of a heavy battery.  It will need to be refilled to be useful.
A chunk of iron-rich earth.  Could be refined with a bloomery.
A large chunk of copper, in its native state.  It only needs to be worked into a more usable shape.
//: Density of one liter of copper, item is native metal.

description: A large chunk of silver, in its native state.  It only needs to be molded into a more usable shape.
//: Density of one liter of silver, item is native metal.

description: A large chunk of native gold, a rare find.  It only needs to be molded into a more usable shape.
//: Density of one liter of gold, item is native metal.  Massivelly heavy.

description: A large chunk of native aluminum, which would have been priceless before other ways to obtain aluminum were invented.  It needs to be cast into an ingot.
//: Density of one liter of aluminum, item is native metal.

description: A large chunk of cassiterite, an ore of tin.  It only needs to be smelted into a usable form.
//: One liter, roughly 6.26 grams per cubic centimeter.

description: A large chunk of galena, a lead ore with small amounts of silver.  It only needs to be smelted into a usable form.
//: One liter, roughly 7.6 grams per cubic centimeter.

description: A large chunk of hematite, an ore of iron.  It only needs to be smelted into a usable form.
//: One liter, roughly 5.04 grams per cubic centimeter.

description: A large chunk of magnetite, a ferrimagnetic oxide of iron.  It can be magnetized to become a permanent magnet itself.
//: One liter, roughly 5.04 grams per cubic centimeter.

description: A large chunk of cinnabar, an ore of mercury.  It is also the historic source for vermilion pigment.
//: One liter, roughly 8.1 grams per cubic centimeter.
